description: This file defines the EmployeePersonalDetailAPI class, a REST API endpoint for retrieving and updating an employee's personal details within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for GET and PUT operations, validation rules, and integrates with employee services and models.

classes.name: EmployeePersonalDetailAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint class for managing employee personal details, including fetching and updating employee personal data.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve personal details for a specific employee identified by 'empNumber'.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update personal details of a specific employee identified by 'empNumber'.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update request parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for deleting employee personal details.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; would provide validation for delete operation.
